Thank you for reading the code. This GitHub repository is a **read-only copy** of
Agentic Cloud Computer: it is refreshed from https://agenticcloudcomputer.com/acc/agentic-cloud
on every merge to main, so pull requests here are not merged.

- Found a bug or have an idea? Please open an **issue** here instead; we read them every day.
- Want to contribute code? Write to adam@agenticcloudcomputer.com first, and read
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/adambaialiev/agentic-cloud/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  outside contributions need a contributor agreement.
